versions.changelog: Broaden the QGA execution reference: off-host Proxmox REST API exec variant, cmd-vs-PowerShell guidance, 8.3 short paths, installer exit-code verification, and validator-safe skill frontmatter metadata. DC lifecycle workflow unchanged.
v1.0.3: add OpenClaw runtime metadata, a Proxmox/AD preflight checklist, and stronger infrastructure automation discovery signaling; no lifecycle command changes.

v1.0.2 — restore display name (no functional change from 1.0.1; security hardening from 1.0.1 retained: schtasks /rp * via stdin, operator-confirmation gates on destructive AD-delete and disk-wipe steps).

v1.0.1 — security hardening from ClawHub scan feedback: schtasks now uses /rp * (password via stdin, never on the command line or in task XML); added explicit operator-confirmation + target-validation gates before destructive AD object deletion and the disk wipe.

Initial release: safe demote/cleanup/reinstall/promote lifecycle for Windows AD domain controllers on Proxmox VMs, driven via QEMU guest agent. Includes verification gates and a field-tested gotchas catalog.
